checks.title: Fault Tree Analysis performed for safety goals
checks.description: Verify FTA exists to analyze causes leading to safety goal violation and identify safety mechanisms.

checks.title: FMEA consistent across system/HW/SW
checks.description: Check FMEA addresses relevant failure modes and is consistent across levels with traceability.

checks.title: FMEDA supports quantitative targets
checks.description: Confirm FMEDA supports required DC, SPFM/LFM/PMHF targets where applicable.

checks.title: Dependent Failures Analysis (DFA)
checks.description: Verify DFA assesses independence assumptions, common resources, and cascading failures.

checks.title: Common Cause Analysis (CCA)
checks.description: Check CCA addresses environmental and design common causes and mitigation strategies.
